'''Galactic Alliance officers''' were [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force|military]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] that served the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] during the later stages of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]<ref name="Force Heretic" /> as well as the [[Dark Nest Crisis]],<ref name="Dark Nest II">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref> the [[Swarm War]],<ref name="Dark Nest III" /> the [[Second Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref> the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]],<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> the [[Sith–Imperial War]],<ref name="Legacy 20">[[Legacy (2006) 20|''Legacy'' (2006) 20]]</ref> and the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="Legacy 9" />
